security.data_classification: Highly Confidential — EDD documentation, correspondent bank financial data
security.access_control: Restricted to Compliance team. EDD documents encrypted at rest.
security.audit: Sanctions screening result logged with screening reference and timestamp

latency.approval_sla: MLR 2017 R34 requires approval before relationship is active — no specific time limit

security.access_control: SMF holder only. Attestation stored immutably.
security.audit: SMF approval with timestamp logged as MLR R34 evidence

per_phase_nfrs.phase_name: Nostro Account Setup and SWIFT Registration

security.data_classification: Financial — nostro account details, SWIFT credentials
security.access_control: Treasury team only. SWIFT BIC credentials are privileged.
security.audit: Account creation and BIC registration logged

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Correspondent Relationship Record Retention
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: CorrespondentRelationship records (including EDD documentation and SM approval) retained for minimum 5 years after relationship termination per MLR 2017.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: MLR 2017 record-keeping requirements for correspondent banking relationships.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Sanctions Screening — No Bypass
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Sanctions screening against the correspondent bank entity, its directors, and beneficial owners must be completed before any approval. No override of a positive sanctions hit is permitted.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: OFSI enforcement; sanctions breach carries criminal liability and significant financial penalties.

regulatory_slas.name: MLR 2017 Regulation 34 — Senior Management Approval
regulatory_slas.requirement: Senior Management approval must be obtained before establishing a new correspondent banking relationship.
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: FCA enforcement; potential criminal liability for MLRO; relationship is illegal without approval

regulatory_slas.name: MLR 2017 Regulation 34 — Annual EDD Review
regulatory_slas.requirement: Correspondent banking relationships must be subject to enhanced ongoing monitoring and annual EDD review.
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: FCA enforcement; potential suspension of relationship
